analysis.finite_sample_note: bootstrap interval and McNemar rely on question-level sampling/exchangeability; shared API drift and public-data contamination remain limits
analysis.opportunities: report pure-tie E and unrestricted E_any; corrections, answered/abstention harms, nonzero questions, outside-top selections, exact decomposition checks
analysis.sensitivity_note: Normal approximation at 80% power, two-sided alpha .05 and specified discordance, not guaranteed power; not designed for 1pp equivalence or deployment admission.
analysis.wqd: descriptive per-question mean pairwise correct-vs-incorrect confidence discrimination; ties .5; only questions with both correct and incorrect valid paths; not independent pair-level inference

comparisons.diagnostic: A21_F0 equals M; T_P restricts to highest-count classes. W_P sums unnormalized ptrue scores. A21_P uses reset state and declared F=3; no attacks are introduced, so this is a clean-pool scope ablation, not an attack test.
comparisons.primary: CISC_P minus M, two-sided exact paired McNemar at alpha .05, question paired bootstrap 10000 percentile 95% CI; existing GSM8K primary retained unchanged
comparisons.secondary_adjustment: Holm across four two-sided exact McNemar p-values; CIs descriptive and marginal
comparisons.ties: CISC uses first occurrence among exactly equal sums as upstream Counter; M first occurrence among count ties; T_P/W_P use unified lex(weight sum,count,-first seat); A21 uses original first-occurrence weighted tie rule.

confidence.prefix: Full original reasoning through first parsed answer closing parenthesis, exactly the upstream answer-span rule; raw untrimmed response is preserved separately. Append original suffix in final assistant message, prefix=true.

ptrue.definition: softmax(logP(0),logP(1))[1], following released per_trace_processing.py; both exact single-byte tokens must be present with finite logprob > -1000. No missing-tail imputation. A one-token length finish is expected and valid only for this likelihood probe.

suffixes.ptrue:
Now I will rate my confidence in the proposed answer as either 0 or 1.
Proposed confidence: (
suffixes.verbal:
Now I will rate my confidence in the proposed answer on a scale of 0-100.
Proposed confidence: (

dataset.note: evaluation subset of public validation, not official hidden test; training exposure unknown; public redistribution license awaits author review
dataset.selection: SHA256 of ca-rc-cisc-csqa-20261022: + source id; ascending; first 100 development, next 600 evaluation

failures.auth_balance: stop scheduling on 401/402/403; resume only transport-completed records; all raw attempts immutable
failures.confidence: missing/invalid score in any parseable seat invokes original-pool M for the respective confidence family; no filtering of weak/failed candidates
failures.generation: non-200, unparsable, or non-stop final response leaves missing seat; no replacement; empty pool abstains

generation.prompt:
You will be given a single-choice question. Answer the question by selecting the letter of the best fitting option.

Before giving your answer, provide a step-by-step explanation of your thought process.
Then on a new line, give your proposed answer adhering to this precise format: 'Proposed answer: (X).', where X is your proposed answer.

The answer MUST ALWAYS be the letter of one of the available options; it CANNOT be "None of the Above".
generation.question_format: upstream build_prompt; options (A): text through (E): text
generation.seed: No undocumented provider seed is sent; seat IDs distinguish independent sampling requests, not reproducible random seeds

positioning: policy scope analysis and reproducible diagnostics; no universal benefit, attack robustness, deployment or monetary claim
study: CommonsenseQA faithful CISC matched readout, v6 extension

tuning.commit: temperature_lock.json written before any test generation; test labels only read during final analysis
tuning.criterion: maximize development accuracy of respective CISC at K=7; ties choose largest T; one frozen T per confidence method; keep original 0-100 scale for verbal scores
tuning.difference_from_original: single new dataset/model with 100 development examples, 7 paths; log-spaced grid explicitly chosen; not replication of original 9-model/4-dataset numbers

unit: question; 7 paths are not 7 independent samples

upstream.fidelity: Released self-confidence prompts, answer-prefix rule, normalized binary likelihood, softmax and first-occurrence tie policy. Hosted chat runner is an adaptation; no KV-cache efficiency claim.
